widget.name: Sortable DnD
widget.description: Drag items between and within lists (e.g. gallery items between kanban lanes). The lists keep loading their own data; this widget only adds dragging and dropping.

property.caption: Role
property.description: Item: something that can be dragged (place it in a list item). Zone: an area items can be dropped in (place it around or inside a list).

property.caption: Group
property.description: Items can only be dropped in zones with the same group name.

property.caption: Item key
property.description: Unique key of this item, passed to the zone's On drop action (e.g. toString($currentObject/ID)).

property.caption: Zone key
property.description: Key of this zone, passed to the On drop action as the source zone of the dragged item.

property.caption: Disabled
property.description: Optional. When true, this item cannot be dragged / this zone does not accept drops.

property.caption: Attach to (CSS selector)
property.description: Optional. When set, the widget does not wrap its content but attaches to the closest ancestor matching this selector (e.g. .kbn-card or .kbn-lane). Lets you add drag and drop next to existing widgets without moving them.

property.caption: Content
property.description: Content that becomes draggable (item) or the drop area (zone). Leave empty when using 'Attach to'.

property.caption: Orientation
property.description: Zone only. Direction in which the items in this zone are laid out; decides whether the drop position is computed from the vertical or horizontal pointer position.

property.caption: On drop
property.description: Zone only. Runs when an item is dropped in this zone.

actionVariable.caption: Item key of the dragged item
Zone key the item was dragged from (empty when it was not in a zone)
Item key of the item it was dropped before (empty = at the end)
0-based position in this zone among the items currently shown, without the dragged item
